sections.label: New York State Education Department report card, postsecondary enrollment
sections.notes: Share of the school's graduates in the calendar-year class who enrolled at any two- or four-year college (New York public or private, or out of state) within 16 months of graduating. Computed from the file's enrolled and graduate counts. Report Card Database https://data.nysed.gov/files/essa/24-25/SRC2025.zip, table Postsecondary Enrollment. Cells NYSED suppresses ("s": fewer than 5 students, and the next smallest group) are suppressed here.

sections.label: New York State Education Department report card, Regents exams (total cohort)
sections.notes: Share of the school's 4-year total cohort (students who entered grade 9 in the cohort year) who scored proficient (Level 3 or higher) on a Regents exam in English language arts, and in any Regents math exam. Students who never tested count in the denominator. Report Card Database https://data.nysed.gov/files/essa/24-25/SRC2025.zip, table Total Cohort Regents Exams. Cells NYSED suppresses ("s": fewer than 5 students, and the next smallest group) are suppressed here.

sections.label: New York State Education Department report card, chronic absenteeism, grades 9–12
sections.notes: Share of the school's students in grades 9–12 (enrolled at least 10 days and present at least one) who were absent for 10% or more of the days they were enrolled. Report Card Database https://data.nysed.gov/files/essa/24-25/SRC2025.zip, table ACC HS Chronic Absenteeism. Cells NYSED suppresses ("s": fewer than 5 students, and the next smallest group) are suppressed here.

sections.label: New York State Education Department, Advanced Placement exams
sections.notes: Share of AP exams taken by the school's students that scored 3 or higher, summed over every AP subject and grade (exams, not students; IB isn't included). NYSED suppresses an exam-and-grade cell with fewer than 5 test takers; the rate uses the reported cells and is withheld (suppressed) when those cover less than 90% of the school's exams. AP/IB Assessment Database https://data.nysed.gov/files/apib/2425/APIB25.zip.
